title: Video Content Editor
description: Remote | Base360.ai Help Shape How The World Sees Base360. Work directly with our founder to turn product launches, founder stories and ambitious ideas into videos that earn attention, make people understand, and move them to act. Meet the founder: Watch this 60-second video About Us Base360.ai is building the AI operating system for short-term rental companies. Our platform grew out of the technology behind The Flex. We’re bringing that technology to other property managers, helping them launch, operate and scale their businesses on AI autopilot. We’re looking for a Video Content Editor who can make a complex product easy to understand and find compelling stories in the people building it. The role You’ll turn raw footage, product recordings and early ideas into launch films, founder content, social videos and ads. Your involvement starts before the first cut. You’ll help shape concepts, identify the strongest angle, suggest hooks and decide how each story should unfold. Then you’ll own the edit through to delivery. Some days, you’ll turn a long founder interview into a sharp, memorable story. On others, you’ll make a product feature instantly understandable or test different openings for an ad. Success means creating videos that hold attention, communicate clearly and get the right people interested in Base360. What you’ll do Create product launches and brand films. Combine storytelling, product demonstrations and motion graphics to show what Base360 makes possible. Turn founder footage into compelling stories. Find the strongest moments in interviews, conversations and behind-the-scenes recordings. Produce content for social platforms. Edit Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn videos with openings, pacing and formats suited to each channel. Develop and test ad creative. Explore different hooks, messages and calls to action, then use performance insights to improve the next version. Own post-production. Handle footage selection, editing, colour grading, sound design, music, captions and final exports. Help define our visual identity. Build a consistent approach to typography, motion, sound and composition across our videos. Use AI to expand what you can create. Generate supporting visuals, voiceovers and other assets where they strengthen the work or speed up production. What you’ll bring A portfolio that shows your judgement. We want to see clear storytelling, deliberate pacing, strong visual choices and attention to detail. Strong editing and motion skills. You’re proficient in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro, with experience in After Effects or an equivalent motion design tool. An instinct for the opening. You know how to create interest in the first few seconds and sustain it through the rest of the video. The ability to simplify. You can find the central idea in a long recording or complex product demonstration and build a clear story around it. An ear for sound. You understand how music, silence, dialogue and sound effects influence the way a video feels. Comfort with AI creative tools. You can incorporate tools such as Runway, Kling, Sora or ElevenLabs into your workflow when useful. Experience with SaaS product videos, founder content, documentary storytelling or paid social ads is a plus. Why join Base360? Work directly with the founder. Help shape the stories behind the product and the business. Have meaningful creative ownership. Bring ideas, develop new formats and influence how Base360 looks and sounds. See your work make an impact. Your videos will support product launches, marketing campaigns and conversations with potential customers. Grow with the company. There’s an opportunity to take on broader creative leadership and help build a video team. Competitive salary and performance incentives. Remote work with an ambitious, entrepreneurial team. How we work We move quickly, communicate directly and take responsibility for what we deliver. You’ll be expected to bring ideas, make creative decisions, meet deadlines and improve your work through feedback. Priorities can change, and experimentation is part of the job. This role suits someone who enjoys taking initiative, cares about both the craft and the outcome, and wants to keep raising the quality of their work.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description: About Us Simprints is a nonprofit tech company with a mission to radically increase transparency and effectiveness in global development. We build ethical, inclusive digital ID powered by biometrics to verify that health, aid, and services truly reach people. Simprints partners with organizations like Gavi to boost immunisation rates in developing countries, Ministries of Health like Ghana on pandemic response, and NGOs like BRAC to deliver maternal healthcare. Studies have shown Simprints increases impact through real-time, precision data, for example increasing maternal health visits by 38% in Bangladesh or accurate HIV tracing by 62% in Malawi. Today we've worked in over 17 countries helping deliver health, aid, and finance to >4M people. Our goal is to transform the way the world fights poverty, ensuring that every vaccine, every dollar, and every public good reaches the people who need them most. About The Role We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to be the champion of our customers, diving deep into their experiences, pain points, and aspirations to ensure that our products not only meet but exceed their expectations. This role is critical in our journey towards achieving and maintaining product-market fit. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, exceptional communication skills, and a passion for customer-centric product development. If building technology for global health sounds exciting, we want to meet you! Job Details Job Title: Senior Technical Product Manager Reporting To: Chief Product Officer Grade/Salary: IC6 - Ethiopia: 6m - 7m Birr. Ghana: 800k-1m Cedis Location: Ethiopia, Ghana or Africa Travel: Frequent travel expected - up to 50% of your time. Department Overview Primary Function: The Product and Engineering department at Simprints is focused on developing innovative biometric solutions to help solve the problems of our users. We take a product-centric approach, ensuring our technology drives social impact through close collaboration and user-focused design. Key Goals: Enhance Biometric Solutions: Continuously improve our biometric products to ensure they are adaptable, reliable, and meet the diverse needs of our users Drive Cross-Company Product Development: Promote collaboration across the entire company to accelerate the delivery of impactful, user-focused features Ensure User Success: Go above and beyond to ensure our users benefit from our technology by providing ongoing support, troubleshooting, and guidance, while actively participating in decision-making and project implementation Role Responsibilities Working within the department to own problems all the way to the delivery of solutions Coordinate dependencies between Mobile and Cloud engineering teams to ensure seamless solution delivery Gathering and synthesising customer insights from internal teams (e.g., Partnerships, Operational Delivery) and external sources (field visits, user interviews, market research) to inform product development Support prioritising high-level problems to solve in the product backlog Reviewing our projects to determine how well our product is performing Work with Engineering Managers who run the development teams, ensuring they are involved and informed. Facilitating their participation in stakeholder calls and field visits to grow their autonomy in their respective teams Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technology and best practices in our sector. Grow our customer obsession in everything we do through education, processes, and tools Requirements 5+ years of experience as a product manager in an agile environment, working on mobile or cloud-based products Strong technical background with the ability to understand and discuss technical concepts with a variety of different audiences. Experience managing technical products and roadmaps Proficiency with an issue-tracking tool (e.g. JIRA, YouTrack) Ability to communicate effectively across many levels, building strong interpersonal relationships with engineers, designers, operational managers, and external stakeholders Benefits 5 Reasons to Join Simprints Life is short. We believe work should be inspirational, meaningful and fun. At Simprints, we're taking on global development's biggest challenges, powered by an amazing culture and incredible people. Work with us, and you will grow faster, learn more, and take on great responsibilities with the potential to make lasting change. Genuine Impact. Work directly with our partners and users to deliver technology that has the potential to impact millions of lives across the globe. At Simprints, you'll be part of a team that is passionate about driving real change An incredible, diverse team. Our work is at the intersection of technology and global development, and we've managed to build an amazing team drawn from all over the world. But don't take our word for it—we're an externally recognised as a Great Place to Work, and a 2025 Best Workplace for Women

title: Senior Manager-Inclusive Financial Ecosystems
description: Job Description: Job Title: Senior Manager-Inclusive Financial Ecosystems Industry: Consulting Experience: 14+ Years Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia Job Type: Full-Time Department: Financial Inclusion & Advisory Services Key Responsibilities: Lead consulting projects focused on financial inclusion and ecosystem development. Develop strategies to improve access to financial products and services for underserved communities. Build and maintain relationships with banks, microfinance institutions, fintech companies, regulators, and development partners. Identify opportunities for digital financial services, mobile banking, and innovative payment solutions. Manage project teams, budgets, timelines, and overall project delivery. Conduct market research, financial ecosystem assessments, and industry analysis. Provide strategic recommendations to clients on financial inclusion and digital transformation. Support the development of partnerships and collaborations across the financial services sector. Monitor project performance and evaluate the impact of financial inclusion initiatives. Prepare reports, presentations, proposals, and strategic recommendations for senior stakeholders. Required Qualification & Experience: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Development Studies, or a related field. 14+ years of relevant professional experience in consulting, financial services, financial inclusion, or ecosystem development. Strong understanding of banking, microfinance, fintech, and digital financial services. Proven experience managing large-scale consulting projects and stakeholder relationships. Experience working with financial institutions, government agencies, and development organisations. Excellent leadership, strategic planning, and problem-solving abilities. Strong communication, presentation, and client management skills. Key Skills: Financial Inclusion & Ecosystem Development Digital Financial Services Strategic Consulting Stakeholder Management Project & Team Leadership Market Research & Analysis Partnership Development Business Strategy & Transformation Client Relationship Management

title: Sales person
description: Company Description Owin Property is a growing real estate company focused on providing reliable property solutions to clients in Addis Ababa and surrounding areas. The organization is dedicated to helping individuals and businesses find suitable residential, commercial, and investment properties. Owin Property values transparent transactions, customer-centered service, and long-term client relationships. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, collaborate, and support each other in achieving sales and service goals. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Sales role based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The Sales person will actively identify and engage potential clients, present available properties, and guide clients through the full sales cycle from initial inquiry to closing. Daily tasks include conducting property tours, responding to client questions, preparing proposals, negotiating terms within company guidelines, and maintaining accurate records of leads and transactions. The role also involves building and nurturing a personal client portfolio, following up on inquiries, collaborating with colleagues on marketing activities, and staying informed about local market trends and pricing. The Sales person is expected to meet or exceed sales targets while providing professional, ethical, and timely service to all clients. Qualifications Proven sales skills, including lead generation, negotiation, and closing deals in a target-driven environment. Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities, with a focus on clear communication and client satisfaction. Familiarity with real estate or property markets in Addis Ababa, or strong interest and willingness to learn quickly. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in Amharic or other local languages is a plus. Ability to work on-site, manage multiple clients and properties simultaneously, and maintain organized documentation. Comfort with basic digital tools (email, messaging apps, spreadsheets, and online listings platforms). Demonstrated integrity, professionalism, and respect for diverse clients and colleagues. Relevant diploma or degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field is preferred, but strong practical experience will also be considered.

title: Head, People & Culture Business Partner, Ethiopia
description: Reporting to the Director, People & Culture Business Partner, Programs, the Head, People & Culture Business Partner, Ethiopia will lead the full People and Culture (P&C) partnership agenda for the Ethiopia portfolio. The role will serve as a trusted adviser to Ethiopia leadership, translating Foundation and country priorities into integrated people, organization, workforce, talent, culture, and leadership actions. As the primary P&C point of contact for the Ethiopia portfolio, the role will provide hands-on support across the employee lifecycle and coordinate delivery with P&C Centre of Excellence, People Services, Legal, and other enabling functions. WAYS YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE Serve as the strategic P&C Business Partner to Ethiopia leadership, translating country and Foundation priorities into an integrated people strategy, roadmap, and delivery plan. Assess organization, leadership, and capability gaps and lead workforce planning for Ethiopia, including demand and supply analysis, headcount planning, critical-role identification, scenario planning, and the resourcing, skills, and leadership priorities required to deliver the country strategy. Work with Talent Acquisition to deliver recruitment and own sourcing and recruitment up to Lead level within agreed accountabilities. Lead organization design and redesign work for Ethiopia, including role clarity, job descriptions, accountabilities, decision rights, RACI, spans and layers, job-evaluation requests, and maintenance of the approved organization structure. Assess the people impact of transformation and organizational change, and lead local change, stakeholder engagement, communication, and adoption plans. Build a high-trust, inclusive, and accountable culture by translating engagement and employee-listening insights into prioritized actions with clear leadership ownership and follow-through. Lead performance and productivity processes in Ethiopia, including goal setting, performance-cycle communications, first-level calibration, recognition, performance improvement, onboarding goals, and probation confirmation within scope. Build people-leader capability through coaching, facilitation, practical tools, and targeted learning, including support for difficult conversations with employees. Lead Ethiopia talent reviews and succession planning, ensuring critical roles have credible succession coverage and employees have clear development and career actions. Manage the annual pay-review process for Ethiopia and prepare recommendations for promotions, lateral moves, new roles, and acting or additional-responsibility arrangements within delegated authority, escalating exceptions to Total Rewards. Use workforce data, dashboards, and qualitative insight to identify trends, test assumptions, and provide evidence-based recommendations to Ethiopia leadership; maintain strong data quality and timely reporting. Manage employee-relations matters, including performance counselling, grievances, disciplinary processes, workplace concerns, and exits, in line with Ethiopian employment legislation, the Ethiopia Employee Handbook, and Foundation policies, ensuring fairness, confidentiality, due process, and appropriate documentation, and coordinating specialist Legal or Employee Relations advice where required. Identify, assess, escalate, and manage people risks across Ethiopia, including workforce continuity, employee relations, compliance, capability, leadership, culture, and change risks. Partner with P&C Centres of Excellence, People Services, Legal, Finance, and other enabling functions to provide an integrated and consistent employee experience while adapting appropriately to the Ethiopia context. Contribute Ethiopia insights to the broader P&C Business Partnering and Programs P&C agenda, and share practical learning across portfolios. Who You Are Postgraduate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field, and/or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience. A professional Human Resources qualification or membership in a relevant professional body is an advantage. 10–15 years of progressive P&C or Human Resources experience in strategically focused roles, including essential senior-level HR Business Partner experience and a minimum of 5–7 years leading and developing teams with evidence of building capability, accountability, and engagement. Demonstrated experience supporting a complex country program or business portfolio in Ethiopia or a comparable African context, with working knowledge of Ethiopian employment practices and experience managing sensitive employee-relations matters with appropriate specialist support. Experience leading workforce planning, organization design and change, talent and succession, performance, and culture interventions, with a practical understanding of role clarity, decision rights, governance, and adoption. Depth in one or more additional P&C disciplines, such as Talent A

title: Head of Payments & Digital Financial Services
description: Genesis Analytics is an Africa-headquartered impact firm that advises governments, businesses, and development organizations on economic, social, financial, and technological challenges across Africa and other young-population regions. Working at the intersection of strategy, policy, and implementation, the firm helps clients tackle complex issues that shape inclusive growth and long-term development. In management consulting, its work spans high-impact engagements that connect deep sector knowledge with practical execution. This role sits at the center of Genesis Analytics' work in Payments and digital finance , with a focus on helping clients navigate transformation across African markets. As Head of Payments & Digital Financial Services, you will shape the direction of a strategic service line, guide senior client engagements, and help expand the firm's influence across the payments ecosystem. The role brings together thought leadership, commercial leadership, and delivery oversight in support of work with public- and private-sector stakeholders. Responsibilities Lead the Payments and Digital Financial Services service line across Africa Set strategy and oversee delivery of complex payments transformation engagements Build partnerships with regulators, financial institutions, fintechs, and development organizations Drive business development, client relationships, proposals, and service-line revenue growth Requirements Higher degree in economics, finance, engineering, or a related field 10+ years of leadership experience in payments, digital finance, or financial inclusion consulting Proven success growing consulting revenue, managing senior client relationships, and leading multidisciplinary teams through complex transformation programs Deep knowledge of African payment ecosystems, including regulation, infrastructure, and market dynamics Hands-on experience with payment rails and switching infrastructure, digital wallet platforms, core banking integrations, or regulatory and market-infrastructure systems Strong relationships with regulators, banks, fintechs, donors, and development organizations Fluency in English for cross-market consulting work; fluency in French or Portuguese for work across Francophone or Lusophone markets is a plus
